create.name: Shiloh Sophia McCloud
create.bio:
Shiloh Sophia McCloud is a painter, teacher and author based in Sonoma, California. Over more than 30 years she has developed Intentional Creativity®, a method that uses intuitive painting, writing, ritual and inquiry as a path of self-discovery, and which is now taught by several hundred certified teachers. She learned from an intergenerational line of women teachers, including her mother Caron McCloud and her mentor Sue Hoya Sellars, which she now calls the Stardust Lineage. She co-founded MUSEA: Center for Intentional Creativity® & Consciousness in Sonoma, which runs a campus, a museum and an online university, and she illustrated Alice Walker's poetry collection Hard Times Require Furious Dancing.

Her teaching treats painting as a contemplative and visionary practice rather than an art lesson, and no experience is needed. Students layer a single canvas over weeks, using intention, movement, the elements and heart-brain coherence practices to listen inwardly and work with symbols that emerge. She has presented at the United Nations Commission on the Status of Women and teaches through week-long online journeys such as Legend, year-long certification trainings, Red Thread circles and courses on The Shift Network. Her books include The Way of the Red Thread and Tea with the Midnight Muse.

books.title: The Way of the Red Thread: Creating a Culture of Connection
books.author: Shiloh Sophia McCloud
books.description: Published by Cosmic Cowgirls in 2023. It sets out the Red Thread approach to gathering in circle, with conversation and ceremony as ways of building connection and community.

books.title: Tea with the Midnight Muse: Invocations and Inquiries for Awakening
books.author: Shiloh Sophia
books.description: A collection of poems, prayers and inquiries written to her community over twenty years. It is meant to be read slowly, as prompts for reflection and creative awakening.

courses.title: The Stardust Lineage Legend
courses.description: A week-long online creative journey through intuitive painting, myth-making and Intentional Creativity, exploring the stories that have shaped you and imagining who you are becoming. Daily optional live connections, with access to the material for six months.

courses.title: Stardust Initiation Training
courses.description: A six-month personal transformation and certified licensing training for coaches, guides and leaders, built on her Stardust Lineage teachings. It opens again in May 2027.

free_resources.title: MUSE Jam Session with Shiloh Sophia
free_resources.description: A free two-hour recorded session from MUSEA. Shiloh Sophia guides a heart-brain coherence meditation, a visioning practice and movement to help you listen to your intuition and act on what you want to create.

free_resources.title: Intentional Creativity Video Teachings with Shiloh Sophia
free_resources.description: A free page of video teachings from MUSEA introducing the lineage, cosmology and practice of Intentional Creativity, including a documentary about the community.
